name: Redis BSON Codec
description: Decode Redis BSON values into type-preserving Extended JSON, with an optional custom external-program codec.

versions.releaseNotes: Initial Windows x64 candidate: bundled BSON to Canonical Extended JSON, workbench reverse encoding and byte-level round-trip checks, plus an optional custom external-program codec. Requires a DBX build with redis-value-codec-v1 (confirmed in v0.6.55 and later source).

zh-CN.name: Redis BSON 编解码
zh-CN.description: 将 Redis BSON 二进制解码为保留类型的 Extended JSON，并支持自定义外部程序。
